fusions.name: The Lantern Kicked Over
fusions.desc: Kicks a lit lantern that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Hot-Iron Mark
fusions.desc: Brands the target with a searing horn strike that deals 24 damage and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Branded Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeing Red
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
